whenToUse: Custom charts that need the shared frame: token colours, legend, loading/empty/error states, text summary.
Configuring series via ChartConfig for any chart in the kit.
avoidWhen: When a ready chart type (Area, Bar, Line, Donut) already fits.
a11y: Always provide a title; the generated summary is the text alternative.
Loading and error states are announced; legend toggles are buttons with pressed state.
